note: Alberta Parks campground on Hwy 11 (David Thompson corridor) 67 km west of Nordegg, run by Westward Bound Campgrounds: a small loop in open grassland and scattered spruce just west of the highway, with walk-in tent sites as well. No cell coverage or debit service; firewood is sold. The Cavalcade group area and the Kootenay Plains trailheads are just south. Five of the first-come sites are listed at 15-20 ft. --Claude
summary: Confirmed against the page, shop list and tear sheet: 16 unserviced drive-in sites (plus 8 walk-in tent sites), $28, May 8 - Oct 3 (2026), reservable sites 1-12 and first-come 13-23, vault toilets, pump water not safe. Added max length 56 ft and the 90-day window. Waterfront and pin questioned in flags.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored creekside - recommend not waterfront): the agency says 'Most sites are found in open grassland, with a few found next to Two O'clock Creek', but no shop site is tagged 'Near Water' and the tear-sheet campground map draws no creek at the loop. On Esri imagery (winter, snow on the ground) the only channel is the incised Two O'Clock Creek gully that Hwy 11 crosses about 190-200 m north of the loop's northernmost sites (1-4), with closed spruce between; nothing within 50 m of any drive-in site. If the agency wording is to be honoured at all it supports creekview at most, and the imagery does not show a view. Imagery is snow-covered, so a small side channel could be hidden.

PIN (about 230 m off, outside the campground): stored 52.06480,-116.41810 sits in forest between the creek gully and the loop, roughly 100 m north of the northernmost site. The loop runs from about 52.0636 to 52.0616; its centre is about 52.0628,-116.4186 (the agency's directions point is 52.06215,-116.41855). Recommend moving to 52.0628,-116.4186.

SHORT SITES: the shop lists first-come sites 014 (16 ft), 015 (15 ft), 021 (20 ft), 022 (18 ft) and 023 (17 ft) under 23 ft; the nine reservable unserviced sites (001, 003-009, 012) are 25-56 ft and first-come 013 and 016-020 are 37-52 ft, so a 23-ft rig fits most of the loop.

SITE COUNT: page table 'Unserviced 16' and 'Walk-in Tenting 8'; the shop lists 19 unserviced numbers plus 5 tent-only (010, 011, 024-026) and the tear sheet numbers 26 sites. 16 written from the page.
PHONE (stored empty): page gives Info 403-721-3975, Facility Operator Westward Bound Campgrounds (the tear sheet lists 403-845-8349 for Kootenay Plains).

TRAILS (not OHV): the tear sheet shows hiking/multi-use trailheads (Kootenay Plains Crag, Two O'Clock Ridge, Bluff Trail) and the Cavalcade group area beside the campground; nothing on the page or tear sheet mentions off-highway vehicles, and nothing about the access road.
2027: the shop shows 'Closed through Thu May 06 2027'; the albertaparks.ca page still carries 2026 dates. No seniors-discount line on this page (unlike Goldeye).
